name: cross-cloud-dependency-and-egress-cost-reporter
description: Maps AWS-to-Azure and Azure-to-AWS dependencies and estimates the data-egress cost and latency of each cross-cloud call, ranking the paths where colocation or caching would save the most. Dollar figures are estimates; Cost Explorer and the Azure billing console are authoritative. Read-only.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on THU at 16:50 UTC
